Weekly Pipeline

What’s new
  • Team / SE are now checkbox lists — pick several; clicking a team heading in the SE list selects the whole team.
  • Analysis buttons on charts open the finding and the list behind it (“Show N …” → searchable, exportable).
  • Pipeline: probability filter, tenders moving up (15% → 30/50/70%), quotations vs required + who quotes enough, hit ratio month by month. Hot Projects (now before Award): conversion, ageing, award-date changes.
  • Award: award vs target trend, how the seasonal pace works (+ year-end projection), who is consistently on target, where the next award comes from. Backlog: delivery list for the invoicing gap. SE Analysis: invoicing vs target and the SE score trend.
  • Existing KPIs, charts and definitions are unchanged.
